Where: <#C07A8STLZ5Z>

Q: @Waco
PAX: @Dizzy @Big Toe @Farmers Only @404 @Toto

*Warmup:*
• Arm Circles
• Piano Man
• Scap Pushups
*The Thang:*
Mashup of some of Waco's favorite hits, Surfs Up, Ladders, and 20% rest.

*Surfs Up - 12 minutes*
PAX form a tight circle, facing inward. Each PAX will hold the “worst” or hardest position of the current exercise (as called by the Q). The Q sets the tone and tempo — the wave starts with him. 1's, then 2's, then 3's and around the wave goes:

• OH Press - 5
• Row - 6
• Squats - 7 
• Shoulder Taps - 8 to Time
*Movement Ladders - 12 minutes*
3 run ladder, moving exercise out to the first cone (rung), jog back, and then out to the next, out to the last, repeat. Loop all for four exercises 'till time.

• Bear Crawl Out - Jog Back
• Lunges Out - Jog Back
• Thread the Needle Out - Jog Back
• Murder Bunny Out - Rifle Carry Back
*20% Rest - 15 minutes (3 sets)*
60 seconds per exercise, AMRAP, x4, then 60 seconds of rest:
• Set 1 - OH Press, Curls, Row, Dead lift
• Set 2 - Heavy Squats, Lunges, PGUs, Calf Raises
• Set 3 - Flutter, Heels to Heaven, LBC , Block Taps.

Warmup
 5 burn down side shuttle hops
10 arm circles
10 reverse arm circles
10 willy mays hays

The Thang
Laddered stations

6 stations, six exercises. At the first station, do the first exercise. At the second station do the first two exercises, at the third the first 3, etc. until doing all 6 at the 6th station. Going back down drop the lowest exercise at each station (do the last 5 exercises at the 5th station, the last 4 at the 4th, etc. until doing just the last exercise back at the first station). After each station do a movement exercise to the outer cones and back before moving on to the next.

10 Burpees --> Bear Crawl
15 Squats -- > Lateral Walking Squat
20 Apolo Ohnos --> Heavy Lunge
25 Deadlifts -->  Murder Bunny
30 Mountain Climbers --> Broad Jump
35 Calf Raises --> Crawl Bear
